from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
for file in ['jobctl.py','jobpipe_queue.py','core/outcomes.py']:
 lines=(repo/file).read_text().splitlines()
 keys=['def _project_csv_outcome','def load_csv_queue','def cmd_apply_csv','def submission_preflight','retryable','Needs user']
 indices=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(key in line for key in keys)]
 print('FILE',file,'MATCHES',len(indices))
 for i in indices[:12]:
  print('LINE',i+1, '\n'.join(f'{n+1}: {lines[n]}' for n in range(max(0,i-3),min(len(lines),i+13))))
result=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
print('STATUS',result.stdout)
